<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Propose planned heads for a path (pure computation, not committed)"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/paths/{pathId}/plan-proposals"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Computes `heads = ceil(charge / plannedRate)` for one path and raises ShiftPlanProposed for visibility — it persists nothing and commits nothing. A human must still call POST /shift-plans to commit an actual ShiftPlan. This is why the response is 200, not 201: no resource is created. When a high observed idle share (idleness-as-staffing-signal, fed back from labor-performance via `LABOR_PERFORMANCE_MODE=kafka-cache`) is available for this path's task type and exceeds `IDLE_SHARE_TRIM_THRESHOLD` (default 0.30), the computed heads are further trimmed (floored at 1 head minimum) and `trimReason` explains why — fail-open: no idle-share signal available applies no trim.

Required on every POST: the service runs on Postgres in every deployment (ADR-0038) and rejects a request without it with 400 idempotency-key-required. Reuse the SAME key for retries of one logical request (same body) — the first response, success or business error, is stored and replayed byte-for-byte for the key's TTL (24h by default) — and a NEW key for each new logical request. Reusing a key with a different request (method, path or body) is rejected with 409 idempotency-key-reused. A key that is not 1-128 printable ASCII characters is a 400 idempotency-key-invalid. (The HTTP stack strips leading/trailing spaces and tabs from the wire value before the service sees it — and no HTTP client can transmit edge whitespace in a header value at all — so the pattern states the post-strip value: it starts and ends with a visible character.) Every POST of this service takes the key; the key is global (looked up by key alone), so one key must never be reused across routes.","schema":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":128,"pattern":"^[!-~]([ -~]*[!-~])?$"},"example":"3f1d6a4e-9c0b-4a39-8f0f-5b2d1c7e9a10"},{"name":"pathId","in":"path","required":true,"description":"The process path's identity (e.g. \"pack\", \"pick\", \"stow\").
